artworks.title: Red Sweet Springs
artworks.medium: color lithograph on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a rural landscape in the "Album of Virginia." The perspective is slightly elevated, revealing a countryside with hills, trees, open fields, grazing cattle, and buildings. The hills are rolling and there is a subtle gradient in the sky. The painting technique is smooth and detailed, depicting the texture of foliage and architecture realistically. The color palette is warm earth tones and muted greens.

artworks.title: Petit paysage en hauteur (Small Landscape)
artworks.medium: etching on japanese paper
artworks.creditLine: Helena Gunnarsson Buhot Collection, Gift in Honor of the Fiftieth Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape filled with tall, slender trees. The horizon is placed just above the midpoint of the image, with distant trees extending towards it. The fine, linear brushstrokes suggest detailing of branches and foliage. Two small, indistinct figures walk on a path surrounded by trees. The color palette is primarily brown and black. The trees in the distance create a sense of depth in the scene.

artworks.title: Cochons au soleil (Pigs in the Sun)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, aquatint, roulette, and stipple on tan japanese paper
artworks.creditLine: Helena Gunnarsson Buhot Collection, Gift in Honor of the Fiftieth Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of pigs. Numerous pigs are clustered together in various poses that convey movement and interaction among the animals. The drawing is done in a monochromatic style using fine lines and cross-hatching to create depth and texture. This technique suggests the fur and form of the pigs, giving them a three-dimensional appearance against the textured background. The setting seems to have a dynamic ambiance, as implied by swirling lines and shadows surrounding the animals. The overall tone of the drawing is earthy and conveys the natural world.

artworks.title: Un Chemin de perdition
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint
artworks.creditLine: Helena Gunnarsson Buhot Collection, Gift in Honor of the Fiftieth Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image is an etching showing a scene with a horseman riding across a rugged landscape. The sky has thick, swirling clouds. The composition is monochromatic using shades of black and grey. Intricate sketches of figures and embellishments are present on the sides. There is high contrast between dark shadows and lighter elements in the image.

artworks.title: La Maison Maudite (The House of the Damned)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and roulette on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Helena Gunnarsson Buhot Collection, Gift in Honor of the Fiftieth Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: Drawing featuring a building, birds flying around, and a black cat in the foreground. The surroundings of the image contain intricate designs depicting various figures. The composition is detailed with fine lines used to create textures and depth.

artworks.title: La Dame aux Cygnes (Woman with Swans)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, roulette, and stipple on japanese paper
artworks.creditLine: Helena Gunnarsson Buhot Collection, Gift in Honor of the Fiftieth Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a person from the shoulders up wearing a long robe, standing near water with three swans swimming nearby. The person is looking towards the distance. They have short hair and a profiled face with fine lines. In the background are trees and shrubbery under a textured sky.

artworks.title: Les Petites Chaumieres (Thatched Cottages -- Small Plate)
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, drypoint, and scraping on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Helena Gunnarsson Buhot Collection, Gift in Honor of the Fiftieth Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image displays a rural landscape with thatched-roof cottages and geese in the foreground. Smoke rises from one of the cottages' chimneys. The scene is depicted from a slightly elevated angle, with a high horizon and a sky filled with clouds. The brushstrokes are fine and detailed, adding texture to the houses and vegetation. The color palette is primarily black and sepia tones, emphasizing the rustic scenery.

artworks.title: Le Petite Enterrement  (The Burial -- Small Plate)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, roulette, aquatint with scraping on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Helena Gunnarsson Buhot Collection, Gift in Honor of the Fiftieth Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a street scene from a slightly elevated point of view. A figure in dark clothing with an umbrella is walking on a wet surface. Behind them, a crowd of people with umbrellas is moving towards the distance. The background features urban structures under a sky with faint light. The artwork uses soft brushstrokes to depict movement in a monochrome color palette of various shades of gray.

artworks.title: Frontispiece for "Les Graveurs du XIXe siècle de Henri Beraldi"
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and roulette with selective wiping on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Helena Gunnarsson Buhot Collection, Gift in Honor of the Fiftieth Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a street view with various elements such as signs, buildings, and a dog. The image features intricate details and a central composition of text and drawings with surreal and symbolic elements. Two figures hold large placards with text, one reading "LES GRAVEURS DU XIX SIECLE par HENRI BERALDI." The backdrop includes a busy street, buildings, and clouds. Surrounding the central frame are smaller engravings, animals, and cityscapes, including what appears to be Rouen. The image is rich in visual information, blending urban, historical, and whimsical imagery.

artworks.title: Lever de lune a Dinard (Moonrise at Dinard)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, roulette, and aquatint, with burnishing on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Helena Gunnarsson Buhot Collection, Gift in Honor of the Fiftieth Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image is of a scenic view overlooking a body of water at either dawn or dusk. In the foreground, leafless trees reach towards the water, with a hill sloping downwards beyond them. The background shows a wide expanse of water with small boats. The color palette is primarily beige and gray. The brushstrokes and etching lines are fine and delicate, emphasizing detail and texture in the tree branches and hill.

artworks.title: The Salon
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Helena Gunnarsson Buhot Collection, Gift in Honor of the Fiftieth Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up seated behind a desk or table. He has a beard and a mustache, with neatly styled hair. He is wearing a suit jacket. The background includes curtains, a chair, and a table with a plant.

artworks.title: Preliminary Sketch for "The Passage" (La Traversee)
artworks.medium: graphite on laid paper, laid down
artworks.creditLine: Helena Gunnarsson Buhot Collection, Gift in Honor of the Fiftieth Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image features three figures depicted from the shoulders up on a textured paper. The first figure on the left wears a hat with a wide brim and minimal facial details. The second figure in the middle has a bearded face, wearing a cap, and simple garment indications. The third figure on the right wears a headpiece and has minimal facial features.

artworks.title: Preliminary Sketch for "The Passage" (La Traversee)
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Helena Gunnarsson Buhot Collection, Gift in Honor of the Fiftieth Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The sketch shows two individuals. One person is depicted in a side profile, standing upright with their face partially obscured as they are bent forward. This individual has short hair and wears what seems to be a long coat, with one hand resting on the head of a cane they are holding. The second person is facing forward, with minimally detailed facial features and hairstyle. They are holding an umbrella over their shoulder, covering part of their back. Both figures appear to be dressed in similar long overcoats. The background consists of abstract, curved lines, suggesting movement or wind, with no distinct environmental details depicted.

artworks.title: Preliminary Sketch for " The Passage" (La Traversee)
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Helena Gunnarsson Buhot Collection, Gift in Honor of the Fiftieth Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The sketch portrays multiple figures in an indoor setting. On the left, a person sits in profile with their arms in their lap, and a hat or hood on. On the right, other figures are seated facing various directions, some close together. Two figures stand at the far right near an exit. The background features minimal details like lines for flooring and walls. The sketch is done in light pencil or ink on a textured background.

artworks.title: The Cab
artworks.medium: graphite, black crayon, and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Helena Gunnarsson Buhot Collection, Gift in Honor of the Fiftieth Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a horse-drawn carriage. The sketch depicts a horse pulling a two-wheeled carriage with quick, loose lines suggesting movement. The drawing lacks fine details and focuses on shapes and forms. The horse is sketched in a minimalistic style, with simple lines indicating its form and movement. The carriage is outlined with a few additional details like the wheel and harness. The drawing appears to capture a fleeting moment, possibly created swiftly to convey the scene's essence.

artworks.title: Three Sheep by a Cottage (recto)/Sketches of Cows (verso)
artworks.medium: black crayon, gray wash, and pen and brown ink on wove paper (recto) graphite, black crayon, and gray wash (verso)
artworks.creditLine: Helena Gunnarsson Buhot Collection, Gift in Honor of the Fiftieth Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image depicts a pastoral scene with a cow grazing in the foreground, while two more cows graze in the distance on sloping terrain. The horizon is softly defined with trees, and a figure with a hat stands to the right. The color palette is subdued, with muted grays and browns providing a calm atmosphere. The brushstrokes and lines are fluid and spontaneous, capturing the essence of the scene. Trees and a structure are sketched in the background.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.medium: ivorytype with applied color
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image shows an oval painted portrait in an elaborate gold frame. The portrait features the upper half of a seated woman facing forward. She has one arm resting on something unseen. She has a composed expression, dark eyes, and dark brown hair styled in an updo. She is wearing an elegant gown with light and dark stripes, floral patterns, lace details at the collar and sleeves, a brooch at the collar, and earrings. In the background, there is a deep blue curtain with tassels. The frame is decorated with floral motifs.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.medium: ivorytype with applied color
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man shown from the waist up, sitting in a formal pose. He is facing slightly to his left, with his right arm resting on a surface draped with a green fabric that has a paisley pattern. His left elbow appears to be resting on his knee. The man has a full beard and mustache, and styled hair with a side part. He is wearing a dark coat with a matching vest, white shirt, and a black bow tie. A gold chain is attached to his vest. The background features a curtain with a tassel, indicating an indoor setting. The portrait is surrounded by an oval frame with floral motifs in gold.

artworks.title: Architectural Capriccio with a Soldier and Dog
artworks.medium: pen and brown and black ink with gray wash over traces of graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: The Edith Tanenbaum Rudolf Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate architectural interior featuring a series of large classical columns with ornate capitals supporting an intricately decorated ceiling with arches. The ceiling is adorned with sculptural elements and decorative motifs, including scrolls and floral designs. In the background, there is a statue or sculptural figure near a set of steps leading to another section of the space. Light and shadow in the drawing highlight the depth and dimension of the architectural features. The precise linework and shading give the space a sense of realism and depth.

artworks.title: Adam and Eve with Cain and Abel
artworks.medium: gouache with pen and brown ink on blue laid paper, laid down
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows four figures in an outdoor setting. On the left, an older male figure is seated, holding a staff or spear, and is dressed in a simple cloth around his waist. Next to him, two small cherub-like figures stand; one is fully visible, and the other is held by a third adult male figure on the right. The standing adult male on the right is shown from the back, with muscular arms and a cloth wrapped around his waist. The background consists of lush greenery with trees and foliage, under a clear sky. The scene is framed in a decorative border.

artworks.title: The Four Evangelists
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk on laid paper, laid down
artworks.creditLine: The Edith Tanenbaum Rudolf Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several mythical creatures in a dynamic scene. The figures are depicted amidst swirling clouds, some have horns and wings. They appear to be interacting closely, with one of them holding an open book. The lines are fluid and energetic, giving a sense of movement. The drawing is in a monochromatic palette, emphasizing the dramatic composition. The style is reminiscent of the Baroque period, featuring complex and animated forms.

artworks.title: The Virgin in Glory
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper, laid down
artworks.creditLine: The Edith Tanenbaum Rudolf Collection
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing of a celestial scene. The image shows a central figure with outstretched arms and surrounded by smaller cherubic figures. The cherubs appear to be floating around the central figure in a dynamic manner. The setting is heavenly with clouds and radiant lines indicating divine light. The drawing features intricate lines, capturing the ethereal and spiritual essence of the scene.

artworks.title: Martyrdom of Saint Lawrence
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over traces of red chalk on laid paper, laid down
artworks.creditLine: The Edith Tanenbaum Rudolf Collection
artworks.description: Drawn with brown ink and shaded with brown wash, three men hold a fourth down on a platform-like heated grate as another bends over to stoke the fire on this horizontal sheet of paper. The man on the grill writhes with hands and one foot lifted high. Another muscular person in the background to the left brings a bundle of planks, presumably firewood. Seven others, including a woman holding a baby, stand mostly in pairs around the grill, some of them leaning on chest-high ledges or against columns. More people are loosely sketched beyond the low wall to the right and looking on from rectangular window openings along the back of the space. Writing in the lower left corner under the image reads, “Luca Cangiazi.”

artworks.title: Putti in the Clouds
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: The Edith Tanenbaum Rudolf Collection
artworks.description: The image shows cherubic figures interacting playfully among swirling clouds. The figures are in relaxed positions, some standing and others reclining or leaning on the clouds. They have round faces with small eyes, gentle smiles, and curly hair. The cherubs are depicted nude, with elegant curves and contours outlining their bodies. They are closely situated together on a plain parchment background.
